item.title: When to Use Static Classes Versus Instance Classes in Software Design
item.description:
“When to Use Static Classes Versus Instance Classes in Software Design”

Deciding whether a collection of functionality belongs within a static class or should be structured as an instantiable object remains a frequent point of debate in software development. While static utility classes appear convenient initially due to their easy, instantiation-free invocation, they introduce significant constraints as systems mature. This exploration details the potential drawbacks of over-relying on static methods and outlines appropriate contexts for their correct application, emphasizing object-oriented principles.

item.title: Resolving .NET Async Deadlocks: A Practical Guide
item.description:
Resolving .NET Async Deadlocks: A Practical Guide

Encountering deadlocks when working with asynchronous operations in .NET can be a significant hurdle, often leading to unresponsive applications or unexpected behavior. This issue typically arises when synchronous code blocks an asynchronous operation that is waiting to be scheduled on the same thread. Let’s dive into effective strategies and practical code examples to navigate these challenges.

Understanding the Deadlock Phenomenon

A common culprit for deadlocks in asynchronous programming involves blocking calls to asynchronous methods. When a synchronous method calls an async method and then blocks waiting for its completion (e.g., using .Result or .Wait()), a deadlock can occur if the asynchronous method needs to resume on the same thread that is blocked. This is particularly prevalent in UI contexts or when using thread pools.

item.title: Struct Mutability: Friend or Foe in .NET?
item.description:
“Struct Mutability: Friend or Foe in .NET?”

The debate surrounding mutable structs in .NET is a fervent one, with strong opinions on whether they are a powerful tool or a dangerous pitfall. This post dives deep into the core of this discussion, examining the arguments for and against their use, and providing practical guidance for developers. We’ll explore how their value type nature impacts behavior, potential pitfalls, and how to wield them effectively.
